gdpr.export: Music: your linked Last.fm account name, your music settings, your daily listening totals and the plays the forum keeps.
gdpr.delete: Music: your linked Last.fm account, your music settings and all of your listening data are deleted.

connect.title: Show what you listen to
connect.text: Connect your Last.fm account and your profile shows what you're playing, your top songs and artists, and how much you listen. Spotify connects to Last.fm in Last.fm's settings. Apple Music and YouTube Music need a scrobbler app or the Web Scrobbler browser extension to send your plays to Last.fm.
connect.help: You'll sign in on Last.fm and come straight back. The forum only reads your plays. You can disconnect at any time, and that deletes your listening data here.
connect.not_configured: Music isn't set up on this forum yet. An admin needs to add a Last.fm API key.

result.connected: Last.fm is connected. Your plays will show up here in a minute or two.
result.taken: That Last.fm account is already connected to another member here.
result.denied: Last.fm didn't approve the connection. Try again.
result.expired: That connection link expired. Try again.
result.failed: Couldn't reach Last.fm. Try again in a few minutes.

status.pending: Getting your plays from Last.fm. This takes a minute or two.
status.private: Your listening is hidden on Last.fm, so the forum can't see it. On Last.fm, go to Settings → Privacy and turn off "Hide recent listening". It comes back here by itself within a day.
status.missing: Last.fm says this account doesn't exist anymore. Disconnect it and connect your current account.

stats.next: {hours, plural, one {# more hour} other {# more hours}} to level {level}
stats.estimate: Listening time is an estimate. Last.fm records each song you play, not how long you listened, so each play counts as the song's length.

settings.title: Your music settings
settings.now_playing: Show what I'm playing right now
settings.leaderboards: Include me in the music charts
settings.leaderboards_help: Off by default. When it's on, your plays count toward the forum's top songs and artists, and you can appear in top listeners.
settings.recap: Get a weekly recap of your listening? Choose it in your notification settings.
settings.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Last.fm? All of your listening data on this forum will be deleted.

charts.title: Music charts
charts.help: Only members who chose to be in the music charts are counted. Listening time is estimated from song lengths.

notifications.recap: Your week in music: {time} across {plays, plural, one {# play} other {# plays}}

settings.notify_recap: Send me a weekly recap of my listening

lastfm.title: Last.fm
lastfm.help: Members connect their own Last.fm accounts. Get a free API key and shared secret at last.fm/api/account/create and paste them here. Set the callback URL there to this forum's address. Last.fm's API is free for non-commercial use.

bands.title: Levels
bands.help: Members get a level from their total listening time. Add as many levels as you like and drag them into order. If a time fits more than one row, the first match wins. Leave "to" empty for the top level.
bands.name: Name (optional)

settings.average_help: Used when neither Last.fm nor MusicBrainz knows how long a song is.
settings.cap_help: No member's day counts for more than this, so fake plays can't push anyone up. Changes apply to new plays.
settings.retention_help: Individual plays older than this are deleted. Totals, levels and charts stay. Minimum 14 days.
settings.default_visibility: Who can see a member's music by default
settings.post_levels: Show members' levels next to their posts
settings.sidebar: Show "Now playing" in the default sidebar
settings.sidebar_help: On the discussion list, when nobody has placed the widget in FoF Forum Widgets. Turn it off if you place it with Bespoke.
settings.rate_help: Last.fm allows 5 per second per server IP. If several forums run on one server, keep each one low.
settings.global_cap_help: A hard limit on how many requests Rotation sends. Polling waits when it's reached.

embeds.title: Players for music links
embeds.help: A link pasted on its own line becomes a player for these services. A link with its own wording stays a link.

recap.subject: Your week in music
recap.body: Last week you listened for {time} across {plays} plays.
